changelog:
v2.9.6 - Face Guard + Broken Screen + Privacy Screen v2

- Face Guard: camera face check on app open. Wrong face -> siren + selfie + location alert to your set number. PIN escape hatch always available.
- Broken Screen prank: heavy shake shatters the screen with crack sound, stays until you tap.
- Privacy Screen v2: fixed dead sensors + new face-down guard + test blackout.
- WhatsApp Guardian photos: wake-and-retry so photos always deliver.
